issues.issue: The note is wrong and garbled. The p3 worksheet (20,100.47, 34%) agrees with the crossed-out p1 (line 30 col 3 20,100.47, cash reserve 34%), not with the unmarked p2 (123,133.86, 205%). Using unmarked p2 is still correct under the rule (a crossed-out page is void even if a worksheet agrees with it), and all p2 amounts match. The reviewer should know the worksheet sides with the void page.
The budget-form rule says to set review: true on every line when the column is labelled 'estimated'. Amounts match the page.
Amount matches the page. The line is 21% of receipts with no description; 'other' with review is defensible, but this fund type is over the 10% threshold for 'other'.
The fiscal year end is assumed, not printed. This follows the rule and is stated in notes.
